detail_contains: not to move and stands in check
why: A Xiangqi document may open from a composed position, so the predicate is what judges one, and this position it refuses: Red is not to move and stands in check, which no position a game could be played from does. The refusal is the setup question's own status wherever that question is asked, not an archive-domain one. It is also why the start is judged before anything is replayed — Black to move with the red general in check is a position offering the capture of a general, and the engine asserts that no capture is one.
